title: Karl-Anthony Towns Knows the Knicks' Win Was Bigger Than Basketball

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代我在夜店打碟的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每晚你都要把300件最珍爱的宝贝带去工作，把DJ台变成一个美丽的、拥有50年历史的微型快闪复古博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜爱的播客平台上收听爱彼表推出的《重构者》。

sentences.en: I'm David Marchese and today I'm talking to NBA champion Carl Anthony Towns.
sentences.zh: 我是大卫·马尔凯塞，今天我采访的嘉宾是NBA总冠军卡尔-安东尼·唐斯。

sentences.en: The seven-foot-tall center for the New York Knicks helped the team secure its first title in 53 years, lighting up the court, the city, and the country.
sentences.zh: 这位身高七尺的纽约尼克斯队中锋帮助球队时隔53年再次夺得总冠军，点亮了球场、这座城市和整个国家。

sentences.en: And landing his fiancée Jordan Woods' bag, which was seen as a lucky charm for the team, in the Guggenheim Museum.
sentences.zh: 他的未婚妻乔丹·伍兹的包包还登上了古根海姆博物馆，被视为球队的幸运符。

sentences.en: Towns grew up in New Jersey, so joining the Knicks in 2024 was something of a homecoming.
sentences.zh: 唐斯在新泽西长大，所以2024年加盟尼克斯算得上是一种叶落归根。

sentences.en: His mother died of complications from COVID in 2020, and he has said her memory fueled him through this year's playoffs.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲在2020年因新冠并发症去世，他说母亲的记忆激励他走过了今年的季后赛。

sentences.en: So what's it like making New Yorkers the happiest they've been, maybe ever?
sentences.zh: 那么，让纽约人体验到可能是有史以来最幸福的时刻，感觉如何？

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with Carl Anthony Towns.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与卡尔-安东尼·唐斯的对话。

sentences.en: Carl Anthony, thank you for being here.
sentences.zh: 卡尔-安东尼，谢谢你来到这里。

sentences.en: I appreciate you having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: You know, even just on the way into the studio, there were people congratulating you, wanted to shake your hand.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，甚至就在走进录音棚的路上，都有人在向你道贺，想跟你握手。

sentences.en: And when I've been talking to Knicks fans, something people will say is, I can't believe that happened.
sentences.zh: 每当我跟尼克斯球迷聊天时，大家都会说的一句话就是，我简直不敢相信那发生了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对啊。

sentences.en: Almost like it was— I still can't believe it happened.
sentences.zh: 简直就像——我到现在还是不敢相信它发生了。

sentences.en: Well, I was going to say, how does it feel to you now, like about a month after it happened?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是想问，事情过去大约一个月后，你现在感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: It still is something hard to believe.
sentences.zh: 这依然是一件很难让人相信的事。

sentences.en: You know, 53 years, me as a Knicks fan growing up, just seeing the Knicks not be able to win the championship.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，53年了，作为一个从小看着尼克斯长大的球迷，眼看着尼克斯无法赢得总冠军。

sentences.en: And to be in a Knicks jersey and be the one to do it with the Knicks, it's an honor, it's a blessing.
sentences.zh: 而现在能身披尼克斯球衣，成为和尼克斯一起实现这一目标的人，这是一种荣誉，也是一种福分。

sentences.en: I still can't fathom that we've done it.
sentences.zh: 我依然无法想象我们已经做到了这一点。

sentences.en: And I keep now being here, and people call me champ, and I'm like, I don't know why they keep calling me that.
sentences.zh: 现在每次来到这里，人们叫我冠军，我都觉得，我不知道他们为什么一直这么叫我。

sentences.en: But it's something that I've earned, and it's something that we've earned, and the city's earned, and the right to be calling ourselves champions.
sentences.zh: 但这确实是我应得的，是我们应得的，是这座城市应得的，我们有资格称自己为冠军。

sentences.en: All right, I want to do some pure, like, Relive the Magic fan service with you right now.
sentences.zh: 好了，现在我想跟你一起重温一下那种纯粹的、粉丝向的“重温神奇”环节。

sentences.en: I think game four of the finals is the game that people are going to be talking about.
sentences.zh: 我觉得总决赛第四场是大家以后会津津乐道的一场比赛。

sentences.en: I don't know what happened in that game.
sentences.zh: 我不知道那场比赛到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: No one knows what happened in that game.
sentences.zh: 没人知道那场比赛发生了什么。

sentences.en: But that's the game that people are going to be talking about years from now.
sentences.zh: 但那是人们在多年后依然会谈论的比赛。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So, first half of that game, you guys are getting your butts kicked.
sentences.zh: 所以，那场比赛的上半场，你们被打得屁滚尿流。

sentences.en: You know, you're down.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你们落后了。

sentences.en: I feel like that was all playoffs.
sentences.zh: 我觉得整个季后赛都是这样。

sentences.en: It was the whole finals.
sentences.zh: 整个总决赛都是如此。

sentences.en: But talk to me about what you were thinking and feeling late in the first half when you're down almost three.
sentences.zh: 但跟我聊聊，在上半场快结束时落后将近三十分的时候，你心里在想些什么，有什么感觉？

sentences.en: Like, I know you're going to say, you know, we just need to hit singles, stay in it.
sentences.zh: 我知道你会说，我们只需要打出安打，留在比赛里。

sentences.en: But was there a moment where we're like, oh, this is just not our night, or they're kicking our butts tonight?
sentences.zh: 但有没有那么一刻，你会觉得，哦，今晚真不是我们的日子，或者他们今晚把我们打得落花流水？

sentences.en: I mean, I'll put the words for you because I know you don't want to say we was getting our ass kicked, for sure.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我来替你把话说出来吧，因为我知道你肯定不想说我们被打得屁滚尿流。

sentences.en: You know, they're hitting shots.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们在进球。

sentences.en: We're not hitting many shots.
sentences.zh: 我们没进几个球。

sentences.en: They're executing at a higher level.
sentences.zh: 他们的执行力比我们更高。

sentences.en: We weren't.
sentences.zh: 而我们没有。

sentences.en: They were bringing more physicality to the game than us, and we weren't.
sentences.zh: 他们在比赛中展现出的身体对抗强度比我们大，而我们没有。

sentences.en: So, we had to take our game to another level and amplify ourselves.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们必须把比赛提升到一个新的水平，激发更强大的自己。

sentences.en: And in the face of adversity, we found ourselves finding our best version in the second half.
sentences.zh: 在逆境面前，我们在下半场找回了最好的自己。

sentences.en: And last year, we had the same situation in Boston, game one and game two, and we found ourselves winning down 20-plus.
sentences.zh: 去年我们在波士顿也遇到过这种情况，第一场和第二场，我们在落后20分以上的情况下实现了逆转。

sentences.en: You know, at halftime, I just told the guys and everyone, you know, we have experience coming back from these moments, especially in the playoffs.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，中场休息时，我对队友们和所有人说，我们有从这些时刻逆袭的经验，特别是在季后赛中。

sentences.en: Just trust our experience, trust each other, and if anything, let's go out there and let's swing for the fences, you know.
sentences.zh: 只要相信我们的经验，彼此信任，如果非要说的话，那就放手一搏，全力挥棒吧，你知道的。

sentences.en: At least give ourselves a chance, you know.
sentences.zh: 至少给自己一个机会，你知道的。

sentences.en: And if not, at least we'll have a different standard walking into the next game.
sentences.zh: 如果不行，至少我们带着一种不同的标准走向下一场比赛。

sentences.en: We build off of this game, get ready for game five.
sentences.zh: 我们从这场比赛中汲取力量，为第五场做好准备。

sentences.en: But this team, man, they're special.
sentences.zh: 但兄弟，这支球队真的很特别。

sentences.en: Have no quit in them.
sentences.zh: 他们骨子里绝不放弃。

sentences.en: And we went out there in the second half, and we found a way to get the job done.
sentences.zh: 我们在下半场上场，找到了完成任务的方法。

sentences.en: And then when in the second half do you really think, all right, this might happen?
sentences.zh: 那么在下半场的什么时候，你真的觉得，好吧，这事儿可能要成了？

sentences.en: Is it, I think it's early in the fourth, you hit the three falling down.
sentences.zh: 是不是，我觉得是在第四节初，你摔倒时投进那个三分球的时候？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, step back.
sentences.zh: 哦，对，后撤步。

sentences.en: Yeah, but when did you really start to think.
sentences.zh: 对，但你到底是从什么时候开始真正觉得有戏的？

sentences.en: Is that not a foul?
sentences.zh: 那难道不是个犯规吗？

sentences.en: No, I'm just playing with you.
sentences.zh: 不，我跟你开玩笑呢。

sentences.en: I know you were trying to get a foul.
sentences.zh: 我知道你当时是想造个犯规。

sentences.en: Don't answer that, don't answer that, don't answer that, don't answer that.
sentences.zh: 别回答那个，别回答那个，别回答那个，别回答那个。

sentences.en: I thought we had a good chance of winning when I walked in the building.
sentences.zh: 我走安检进大楼的时候就觉得我们有很大的赢面。

sentences.en: Oh, come on.
sentences.zh: 哦，拜托。

sentences.en: I felt really good.
sentences.zh: 我当时感觉真的很好。

sentences.en: And I told my wife, I told everybody, I felt really, really good about the game.
sentences.zh: 我告诉了我妻子，我告诉了所有人，我对这场比赛感觉真的非常好。

sentences.en: Obviously, as the first half was going on, I was like, man, maybe I was wrong.
sentences.zh: 当然，随着上半场的进行，我在想，天哪，也许我猜错了。

sentences.en: First half didn't give me the best feelings.
sentences.zh: 上半场并没有给我带来最好的感觉。

sentences.en: But the second half, I think as soon as we got it into that 15-point range, I felt really good about our team finding a way to win.
sentences.zh: 但下半场，我想一旦我们把分差追到15分左右，我就对我们球队找到赢球方法充满了信心。

sentences.en: And do you feel in that moment when you started to claw back and getting closer, do you feel the Spurs tightening up?
sentences.zh: 当你开始反扑并不断迫近比分的那一刻，你能感觉到马刺队开始紧张了吗？

sentences.en: What is your analysis of what's happening on the other side?
sentences.zh: 你对场上发生的局势有什么分析？

sentences.en: I think sometimes when you're a young team, you look to not lose the game, and we were looking to win the game.
sentences.zh: 我想有时候当你是一支年轻球队时，你满脑子想的是怎么别输掉比赛，而我们想的是怎么赢得比赛。

sentences.en: And that was what made us bring such an aggression to the game.
sentences.zh: 这就是让我们在比赛中展现出如此强烈侵略性的原因。

sentences.en: And I think they were trying to protect the lead.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们当时在试图守住领先优势。

sentences.en: And if you looked at our playoff run, you've seen us get a lead.
sentences.zh: 如果你看过我们的季后赛征程，你会发现我们取得领先时，

sentences.en: And instead of protecting the lead, we're trying to build the lead.
sentences.zh: 我们不是在死守领先，而是在试图扩大领先优势。

sentences.en: I think there was also one stretch, too, where maybe they took something like nine three-pointers in a row.
sentences.zh: 我觉得还有一个阶段，他们好像连续投了差不多九个三分球。

sentences.en: And you feel like maybe a more mature team takes a different approach.
sentences.zh: 你觉得一支更成熟的球队可能会采取不同的策略吗？

sentences.en: You know, it's so weird because when you're in the game, that's why a lot of times I know reporters hate when we say,
sentences.zh: 你知道，这真的很怪，因为当你身处比赛之中的时候——这就是为什么很多时候我知道记者们讨厌我们说，

sentences.en: I got to watch the game to actually give you an honest answer on the situation you're asking.
sentences.zh: 我得看比赛录像才能对你提出的情况给出诚实的回答。

sentences.en: But because in the game, I didn't realize, and this is my first time hearing, that they took nine threes at one point.
sentences.zh: 因为在比赛中我根本没意识到，这也是我第一次听说他们当时连续投了九个三分。

sentences.en: And again, I mean, even if it was six, seven, eight, we weren't aware of that because we're so locked into the game just trying to find a way to get a stop,
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我的意思是，哪怕是六个、七个、八个，我们当时也没注意到，因为我们太专注于比赛了，满脑子只想着怎么完成一次防守，

sentences.en: go back down the court, and make a bucket.
sentences.zh: 然后推过半场去投进一个球。

sentences.en: You're not really thinking about what type of shots they're shooting.
sentences.zh: 你根本不会去想他们在投什么类型的球。

sentences.en: You're just, I just need to get a stop at all costs, whatever it takes, whatever threes they hit.
sentences.zh: 你只是在想，我无论如何都要完成一次防守，不管付出什么代价，不管他们投进什么三分。

sentences.en: They hit two big threes.
sentences.zh: 他们确实投进了几个关键三分。

sentences.en: He's, what, De'Aaron Fox hit a left wing three, and then Victor Bonamayama hit a pull-up two-pointer.
sentences.zh: 达龙·福克斯投进了一个左翼三分，然后维克托·韦姆班亚马投进了一个急停两分。

sentences.en: They hit some shots at the end, but we did such a great job as a team just sticking with it, finding ways to make that one bucket, get that one stop.
sentences.zh: 他们在最后阶段投进了一些球，但作为一支球队，我们做得很棒，一直咬住不放，想方设法投进那一记关键球，完成那一次关键防守。

sentences.en: And of course, the right hand of God came through with OG getting the tip in.
sentences.zh: 当然，上帝之手显灵了，OG完成了补篮。

sentences.en: All right, you need to tell me about OG's play.
sentences.zh: 好了，你得跟我讲讲OG的那记进球。

sentences.en: What, where are you on the court?
sentences.zh: 当时你在球场的什么位置？

sentences.en: What is your sense of?
sentences.zh: 你当时的直觉是什么？

sentences.en: I'm right next to him.
sentences.zh: 我就在他旁边。

sentences.en: I was going to dunk it.
sentences.zh: 我本来打算去暴扣的。

sentences.en: I was going to dunk it in.
sentences.zh: 我本来打算补扣进去的。

sentences.en: I was going to dunk it.
sentences.zh: 我本来要扣的。

sentences.en: I seen OG flying in the sky, and I'm like, all right, well, if he tries to tip the ball back in
sentences.zh: 我看到OG像飞一样冲向空中，我在想，好吧，如果他试图把球点补进去

sentences.en: and it doesn't, it goes long and it goes off the front end, I'm going to dunk it back in.
sentences.zh: 但没进，球飞得太远砸在前沿上，那我就把球补扣进去。

sentences.en: OG made it.
sentences.zh: OG把球打进了。

sentences.en: It was something special.
sentences.zh: 那真是一个特别的时刻。

sentences.en: You know, the play was designed to go to me, and then two people guarded me, inbounder and the person
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那个战术本来是设计传给我的，然后有两个人防我，发底线球的人和我

sentences.en: defending me, and we finally, we got the ball to JB, and JB took a quick pull-up three,
sentences.zh: 身边的防守人，最后我们把球传给了JB，JB迅速急停投了一个三分，

sentences.en: and OG, who was inbounding the ball, found himself with no one on him, and he crashed to the board
sentences.zh: 而负责发底线球的OG发现自己周围无人防守，于是他冲向篮板

sentences.en: and got an offensive rebound, which was to tip in, and found a way to make the bucket.
sentences.zh: 抢到了进攻篮板并顺势补篮，把球打进了。

sentences.en: I mean, it's going to go down as one of the greatest plays in New York history, one of the greatest plays in NBA Finals history.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这将被载入纽约历史上的伟大进球之一，也是NBA总决赛历史上的伟大进球之一。

sentences.en: And then when you see that ball go through the hoop, what is the feeling that goes through your body at that moment?
sentences.zh: 当你看到那个球穿过篮网时，那一刻你身体里的感觉是什么？

sentences.en: Are you even having thoughts?
sentences.zh: 你当时甚至还有时间思考吗？

sentences.en: No, when you see me in the game, you see me telling everybody, it's so loud.
sentences.zh: 不，如果你看我在场上的画面，你会看到我在叫大家安静，现场声音太大了。

sentences.en: I didn't hear the whistle.
sentences.zh: 我根本没听到哨声。

sentences.en: So I just see people running on the court, so my first reaction is to tell everyone, get off the court right now, and like, let's stay focused on the game.
sentences.zh: 我只看到人们冲进球场，所以我的第一反应是告诉所有人，现在马上离开球场，保持专注继续打比赛。

sentences.en: But then I realize, I look back, and I see the ref grabbing the ball, and I'm like, oh, it's a timeout.
sentences.zh: 但随后我意识到，我回头看到裁判抓住了球，我想，哦，原来是暂停。

sentences.en: I see OG, and OG's very, you know OG, how he is.
sentences.zh: 我看到了OG，OG这个人嘛，你了解OG的脾气。

sentences.en: He doesn't have a lot to say.
sentences.zh: 他平时话不多。

sentences.en: Everyone, this is New York Times.
sentences.zh: 各位，这是纽约时报。

sentences.en: That means New York all knows how OG is.
sentences.zh: 这意味着纽约所有人都了解OG是什么样的人。

sentences.en: And I just saw him, and it was one of those things, you know, you want to hype him up and stuff.
sentences.zh: 我看到他的时候，你知道就是那种你想好好庆祝一番、嗨一下的时刻。

sentences.en: But I have such a close friendship with OGs.
sentences.zh: 但我跟OG有着非常深厚的友谊。

sentences.en: One of my best friends, I was like, nah, you're going to get a hug for this one.
sentences.zh: 作为我最好的朋友之一，我说，不，这次你必须得挨个抱抱。

sentences.en: This is a career-changing bucket for all of us at one time.
sentences.zh: 对我们所有人来说，这是一个改变职业生涯的进球。

sentences.en: And he gave us a chance.
sentences.zh: 他给了我们一个机会。

sentences.en: We still had to get a stop, and he gave us a chance to get that stop.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然需要完成防守，而他给了我们去完成那次防守的机会。

sentences.en: But bless, and God is good to us.
sentences.zh: 真主保佑，上帝对我们真好。

sentences.en: I was able to get a hand on the basketball, too.
sentences.zh: 我也能够碰到底线球的发球。

sentences.en: On the inbound, on the next play.
sentences.zh: 在下一个回合的发球防守中。

sentences.en: Yeah, for the inbound for Castle.
sentences.zh: 对，防守卡尔时的发球。

sentences.en: Did OG ever have more to say about that play in the locker room?
sentences.zh: 更衣室里，OG有没有多说一点关于那个进球的事？

sentences.en: Did he do the same?
sentences.zh: 他还是老样子吗？

sentences.en: No, of course not.
sentences.zh: 不，当然没有。

sentences.en: No, OG went in the locker room.
sentences.zh: 不，OG走进更衣室时。

sentences.en: You know, he did the usual OG.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他还是那个老样子OG。

sentences.en: He has no reaction, no emotion on his face whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 他脸上没有任何反应，没有任何情绪波动。

sentences.en: And he was just like, yeah, I guess I made it, I guess.
sentences.zh: 他只是说，好吧，我想我把它投进了吧，大概吧。

sentences.en: You know OG.
sentences.zh: 你了解OG的。

sentences.en: OG's too funny, man.
sentences.zh: OG太逗了，兄弟。

sentences.en: There's another moment from the series I want to ask you about.
sentences.zh: 系列赛中还有另一个时刻我想问问你。

sentences.en: I think you had just scored against Wemby.
sentences.zh: 我想当时你刚刚在文班头上得分。

sentences.en: And maybe it was a timeout, a TV timeout.
sentences.zh: 也许当时是个暂停，电视暂停。

sentences.en: And you're coming off the court.
sentences.zh: 你正要下场。

sentences.en: And, you know, we're not supposed to curse here.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我们这里不应该说脏话。

sentences.en: But the cameras caught you saying something like...
sentences.zh: 但摄像机捕捉到你说了一些类似于……

sentences.en: Oh, something like something else.
sentences.zh: 哦，类似于别的东西。

sentences.en: He can't fudge with me, maybe what you said.
sentences.zh: 他防不住我，你可能说了类似这样的话。

sentences.en: But did you feel like you had understood something about how to play against him?
sentences.zh: 但你当时是不是觉得自己已经摸清了该怎么防守他？

sentences.en: Or what was that in response to?
sentences.zh: 或者说那句话是对什么的反应？

sentences.en: I was just being competitive.
sentences.zh: 我当时只是好胜心切。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It's all respect to the opponents and stuff.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是对对手的尊重之类的情绪。

sentences.en: I just was being competitive.
sentences.zh: 我只是好胜心强。

sentences.en: And I have tremendous confidence in my ability and what I do and the work I put in.
sentences.zh: 我对自己的能力、我的所作所为以及我付出的努力有着无比强大的自信。

sentences.en: So, you know, it was the moment.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，那只是情理之中的真情流露。

sentences.en: It's the NBA Finals.
sentences.zh: 这是NBA总决赛。

sentences.en: And you're on the biggest stage against one of the best players in the world.
sentences.zh: 你登上了最大的舞台，面对的是世界上最好的球员之一。

sentences.en: And I wanted to prove again, after all these years, prove again where I stand in the NBA.
sentences.zh: 我想再次证明，在经历了这么多年的风雨之后，再次证明我在NBA的地位。

sentences.en: Yeah, because you had to take it a little personally just as a competitor, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，因为作为竞争者，你多少得有点个人情绪，对吧？

sentences.en: To hear...
sentences.zh: 听到……

sentences.en: Nah, I mean, I juSt...
sentences.zh: 不，我的意思是，我只是……

sentences.en: Well, to hear how much people were talking about Wemby before.
sentences.zh: 我是说，听到之前人们对文班的讨论那么多。

sentences.en: I don't...
sentences.zh: 我没有……

sentences.en: I'm glad.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴。

sentences.en: He deserves it.
sentences.zh: 他实至名归。

sentences.en: He's a generational player.
sentences.zh: 他是划时代的球员。

sentences.en: He's a 7'5", 7'4", whatever you want to say.
sentences.zh: 他身高7英尺5寸、7英尺4寸，随便你怎么说。

sentences.en: He's extremely tall.
sentences.zh: 他真的非常高。

sentences.en: And he's God-gifted with intangibles that none of us were able to get.
sentences.zh: 而且他天赋异禀，拥有我们谁都无法企及的特质。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm 7'4", thank God.
sentences.zh: 我是说，谢天谢地，我身高7英尺4寸。

sentences.en: But 7'4", would have been cool too.
sentences.zh: 不过7英尺4寸其实也挺酷的。

sentences.en: And he deserved it.
sentences.zh: 而且他实至名归。

sentences.en: But, you know, I've earned my stripes in this league too.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我在这个联盟里也打出了自己的一片天。

sentences.en: And I'm a competitor.
sentences.zh: 我是一个竞争者。

sentences.en: And I wanted to go againSt...
sentences.zh: 我想去面对……

sentences.en: I always say I want to go out there and play against the beSt.
sentences.zh: 我总是说我想上场跟最好的人交手。

sentences.en: And I was out there with one of the beSt.
sentences.zh: 而我当时确实在和最优秀的球员同场竞技。

sentences.en: And we just wanted to compete at a high level.
sentences.zh: 我们只是想在极高的水平上竞争。

sentences.en: And when you talk about being a competitor, I think you're known for being a nice guy, a sweet guy.
sentences.zh: 说到竞争意识，我觉得大家都知道你是个好人，性格很温和。

sentences.en: Even just talking to you now, like, you know, you smile easily.
sentences.zh: 甚至就凭现在跟你聊天，你看，你很容易笑。

sentences.en: You have a nice disposition.
sentences.zh: 你的性格很好。

sentences.en: You were joking around in the green room.
sentences.zh: 你在演播厅后台也总是开着玩笑。

sentences.en: But I can imagine that being, you know, a professional basketball player pushes you towards a kind of, you know, aggression or hardness.
sentences.zh: 但我可以想象，你知道的，职业篮球运动员的身份会逼着你产生某种好胜心或强硬的一面。

sentences.en: And is that something that came naturally?
sentences.zh: 这是你天生就有的吗？

sentences.en: Or did you feel like you had to develop that side of who you were?
sentences.zh: 还是说你觉得你不得不培养自己这方面的性格？

sentences.en: I was definitely more aggressive when I was younger.
sentences.zh: 我年轻的时候确实更具有侵略性。

sentences.en: When you were younger, you were more aggressive.
sentences.zh: 你年轻时更具有侵略性。

sentences.en: I just had a mean streak to me because I understood what it was to be the young kid playing with the older kids, playing basketball.
sentences.zh: 我身上就是有一股狠劲，因为我懂那种作为小孩跟大孩子们一起打篮球的感受。

sentences.en: There's no respect given to the young kid, especially to the younger brother.
sentences.zh: 没人会给小孩子面子，尤其是对弟弟。

sentences.en: So I had to go earn it.
sentences.zh: 所以我必须去争取尊重。

sentences.en: And every day I learned how to earn it when I was 13 playing U16 basketball, U17 basketball,
sentences.zh: 在我13岁打U16、U17的比赛时，我每天都在学习如何去赢得这种尊重，

sentences.en: going out there and competing against the best of the best at age groups way higher than mine.
sentences.zh: 去和那些远超我年龄段的顶尖高手同场竞技。

sentences.en: And, you know, when you're doing that, you understand, you know, you got to bring that kind of aggression to the game, especially for me at the time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你经历这些时，你就会明白，你必须在比赛中带上那种侵略性，特别是对我当时的情况而言。

sentences.en: I wasn't physically mature yet to dominate or out-physicality these older kids.
sentences.zh: 我当时身体还没完全发育成熟，无法在体型上压制或胜过这些大孩子。

sentences.en: So you learn how to get crafty with it.
sentences.zh: 所以你得学会用技巧去周旋。

sentences.en: You learn how to get a little finesse with the game.
sentences.zh: 你得学着让比赛带点细腻的技术。

sentences.en: And then as I got older, I had the finesse.
sentences.zh: 后来随着我年龄增长，我具备了这种细腻的技术。

sentences.en: I learned the physical attributes, you know, to playing against older kids.
sentences.zh: 我掌握了与大孩子对抗所需的身体素质，你知道的。

sentences.en: I actually got my, you know, my strength.
sentences.zh: 我的力量其实也练出来了。

sentences.en: I got my maturity going.
sentences.zh: 我的心态成熟了。

sentences.en: So while doing that, I also learned, you know, how to maintain it.
sentences.zh: 所以在经历这些的同时，我也学会了如何保持这种状态。

sentences.en: My mom taught me really well how to take that aggression and utilize it to my advantage and also be passionate about the game and how to love playing the game at the highest level.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈教得很好，教我如何将那种侵略性转化为我的优势，同时也对比赛充满激情，懂得如何在最高水平上热爱比赛。

sentences.en: You spoke very movingly, I think it was after game one, right, about your mom in an on-court
sentences.zh: 我觉得你表达得非常感人，好像是在第一场比赛结束后，对吧？你在场边采访时提到了你妈妈，

sentences.en: interview where, you know, you lost her during COVID and you talked about how, you know, she was kind of there with you.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你在疫情期间失去了她，你谈到她仿佛一直陪在你身边。

sentences.en: And it seemed clear that this idea that in a way you were playing for her was motivating.
sentences.zh: 很显然，某种程度上你在为她而战，这成了你的动力。

sentences.en: Is that actually what was going on?
sentences.zh: 当时真实的情况是这样的吗？

sentences.en: Did you think during the playoffs, like, I am here trying to commemorate my mother in a way?
sentences.zh: 你在季后赛里会想，比如，我在这里某种程度上是为了纪念我的母亲吗？

sentences.en: Like, what were you thinking about in terms of her throughout?
sentences.zh: 整段旅程中，你对她的想法是怎样的？

sentences.en: For me, I think about the finals and I say, you know, I've dedicated my life to this game.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，每当我想起总决赛，我就会说，我把一生都奉献给了这项运动。

sentences.en: I've dedicated my time with her and precious time.
sentences.zh: 我把本可以和她在一起的时间、宝贵的时间都投入进去了。

sentences.en: I could have been hanging out with her, enjoying life with her.
sentences.zh: 我本可以陪着她，和她一起享受生活。

sentences.en: I spent it in the gym, working on my game, working on my craft, playing basketball games,
sentences.zh: 但我把时间花在了健身房里，打磨我的球技，钻研我的技术，打篮球比赛，

sentences.en: you know, getting treatment on my body, getting ready for the next game, you know, mentally, not maybe always being 100% present because I'm thinking about that opponent.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，给身体做理疗，为下一场比赛做准备，在精神上，也许我并不总能百分之百全神贯注，因为我在想着下一个对手。

sentences.en: I'm thinking about that team that has coming up.
sentences.zh: 我在想着即将对阵的那支球队。

sentences.en: We got that big game coming up.
sentences.zh: 我们接下来有场硬仗要打。

sentences.en: So I've sacrificed so much for this game.
sentences.zh: 所以我为了这项运动牺牲了太多。

sentences.en: It would be a disservice to her if I didn't try to capitalize on this opportunity as much as possible.
sentences.zh: 如果我没有尽可能地抓住这次机会，那就太对不起她了。

sentences.en: So I wanted to make her proud and I wanted to maximize this opportunity because I've worked my whole life for it.
sentences.zh: 所以我想要让她骄傲，想要把这次机会发挥到极致，因为我为此奋斗了一生。

sentences.en: And did you find yourself thinking about her at moments during the games?
sentences.zh: 在比赛的某些时刻，你会发现自己会想起她吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I think about her all the time.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我无时无刻不在想她。

sentences.en: It's not just basketball.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是关于篮球。

sentences.en: My life doesn't revolve around basketball.
sentences.zh: 我的人生并不围绕着篮球转。

sentences.en: It's just my job.
sentences.zh: 这只是我的工作。

sentences.en: But I still have a whole life outside that revolves not around basketball.
sentences.zh: 我还有丰富的生活，其核心并非篮球。

sentences.en: And I think about her with the basketball in hand and not.
sentences.zh: 无论手里拿着篮球还是不拿，我都会想起她。

sentences.en: After you guys won, who was most meaningful for you to celebrate with in terms of sort of remembering your mom and having this?
sentences.zh: 你们夺冠之后，对你来说，和谁一起庆祝最具有意义，比如能让你纪念妈妈并拥有这一切？

sentences.en: Remembering my mom?
sentences.zh: 纪念我的妈妈？

sentences.en: My wife.
sentences.zh: 我的妻子。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, being with Jordan, I think was great.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，能和乔丹在一起真的很棒。

sentences.en: You know, the next closest woman in my life was there and able to, you know, celebrate that moment with me
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我生命中第二重要的女性就在那里，能够和我一起庆祝那个时刻，

sentences.en: and seeing all the trials and tribulations it took to get there, you know, trading from Minnesota to New York, coming up short last year.
sentences.zh: 见证了走到这一步所经历的所有艰难险阻，你知道的，从明尼苏达被交易到纽约，去年功亏一篑。

sentences.en: Remember this year, all the rumors and everything, trade rumors and stuff.
sentences.zh: 还记得今年所有的流言蜚语，那些交易流言什么的。

sentences.en: And then to still find yourself in the spot winning the championship is, you know, a testament to her love.
sentences.zh: 然后最终发现自己站在那个位置赢得了总冠军，你知道的，这是对她付出的爱的最好证明。

sentences.en: She's given me all and the support she's given me and to my father as well, who has been with me every step of the journey since birth.
sentences.zh: 她倾其所有给予我支持，还有我父亲也一样，从我出生起他便陪伴着我走过每一步。

sentences.en: And it was really special.
sentences.zh: 这真的非常特别。

sentences.en: I think the most meaningful one after I spoke on was Patrick Ewing, just to see all that, just all that years of misery.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自我倾诉之后最具有意义的时刻，是和帕特里克·尤因在一起，看着他经历的所有那些年的痛苦。

sentences.en: And it's just that exhale he had, you know, I could tell he just had the weight of the world on his shoulders.
sentences.zh: 看着他长舒的那一口气，你知道的，我看得出来他肩上背负着整个世界的重量。

sentences.en: And for finally, for the first time, he could like breathe and he could see the end goal for the Knicks.
sentences.zh: 他终于可以第一次畅快呼吸，看到了尼克斯队的终极目标。

sentences.en: We had talked about this moment since I got here and I've leaned on his experience, his wisdom.
sentences.zh: 自从我来到这里，我们就一直在讨论这个时刻，我一直仰仗他的经验和智慧。

sentences.en: And not only that, he's become a really, really great friend of mine and someone I love to just pick up the phone and just talk with and have a good time.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，他成了我非常非常要好的朋友，一个我随时想打电话聊天、享受美好时光的人。

sentences.en: And I know while he may have been disappointed that he was not the one in the jersey bringing it home, he is the Knicks culture.
sentences.zh: 我知道，尽管他可能会因为自己没能穿上球衣把冠军带回家而感到遗憾，但他就是尼克斯的文化。

sentences.en: He is the Knicks team, you know, he's the most recognized Knick of all time.
sentences.zh: 他就是尼克斯这支球队，你知道的，他是史上最具标志性的尼克斯球员。

sentences.en: And especially in my life that I've been able to recognize and see.
sentences.zh: 特别是在我的人生记忆里，我所能认识和看到的。

sentences.en: So he's played against my dad, too.
sentences.zh: 而且他也曾和我父亲交过手。

sentences.en: And just to see that moment happen and to see him finally get that moment to hold the trophy, I knew how much it actually meant to him on the side as well.
sentences.zh: 能看到那个时刻发生，看到他终于有机会高举奖杯，我深知这对场边的他来说意味着什么。

sentences.en: What did you guys say to each other after you won?
sentences.zh: 你们赢球后对彼此说了些什么？

sentences.en: No, it just simply, this was something that he needed to see in life.
sentences.zh: 没说什么，很简单，这是他有生之年必须见证的时刻。

sentences.en: And I'm just honored I was able to make it happen and help him, help this team make it happen for him.
sentences.zh: 我很荣幸能让它成为现实，并帮助他、帮助这支球队为他实现这个愿望。

sentences.en: And I think the way that in press conferences and, you know, in on-the-court interviews after the games,
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得，在赛后的新闻发布会和场边采访中，

sentences.en: the way that you're willing to show your emotion and be vulnerable in those moments.
sentences.zh: 你总是愿意展露情感，在那些时刻表现得极其脆弱真实。

sentences.en: And be yourself.
sentences.zh: 并且做你自己。

sentences.en: And be yourself is not something that, um, I don't know that it's something that we necessarily encourage in professional athletes.
sentences.zh: 做你自己这件事情，呃，我不知道这是否是我们通常在职业运动员身上会鼓励的东西。

sentences.en: Is that something that you consciously decided you were going to be willing to put yourself out there in that way?
sentences.zh: 这是你刻意决定要以这种方式向公众敞开心扉吗？

sentences.en: No, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不，不。

sentences.en: You just can't be any other way?
sentences.zh: 你只是没法成为别的人？

sentences.en: I'm just, I'm just myself.
sentences.zh: 我只是，我只是做我自己。

sentences.en: I'm trying to be anybody.
sentences.zh: 我没想去模仿任何人。

sentences.en: I'm just trying to answer the questions as honestly as I can.
sentences.zh: 我只是尽可能诚实地回答问题。

sentences.en: And, and, and, and doing that, I'm just, I guess my personality shows itself sometimes.
sentences.zh: 在那样做的过程中，我只是，我想我的性格有时自然而然地流露出来了。

sentences.en: And, uh, I'm not going to say sorry for any of it because that's how my mother raised me.
sentences.zh: 而且，呃，我不会为这其中的任何一点道歉，因为这就是我母亲抚养我长大的方式。

sentences.en: She told me to be comfortable in my skin.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我要坦然做自己。

sentences.en: I've always been comfortable in my skin and, uh, to never diminish my light and my value to, uh, help other people's narratives and opinions, uh, get amplified.
sentences.zh: 我一直都对自我感到坦然，呃，并且绝不为了迎合别人的话语和观点、去成全别人的刻意放大而贬低自己的光芒和价值。

sentences.en: Have you learned anything from Jordan Woods about how to be a public figure?
sentences.zh: 你从乔丹·伍兹那里学到过如何成为一个公众人物吗？

sentences.en: Cause you know, she's obviously an influencer, an actress.
sentences.zh: 因为你知道，她显然是个网红、演员。

sentences.en: What is, what is she taught you?
sentences.zh: 她教给了你什么？

sentences.en: It's, it's, it's, it's, uh, I guess you could say a relationship in Hollywood hasn't lasted as long as ours.
sentences.zh: 这，这，这，这，呃，你可以说，好莱坞很少有感情能像我们这样维持这么久。

sentences.en: Like usual, it doesn't do it.
sentences.zh: 像通常那样，它们都无法持久。

sentences.en: That's just kind of not the norm.
sentences.zh: 那似乎并不是常态。

sentences.en: And then we found ourselves, uh, finding each other at the foundational level of just being friends for years.
sentences.zh: 而我们发现彼此是在最基础的层面上建立联系，做了多年的朋友。

sentences.en: And now we're here with wedding bells, uh, incoming soon.
sentences.zh: 现在我们走到了这一步，婚礼的钟声，呃，马上就要敲响了。

sentences.en: So I think for her, she's just taught me so much about, um, about myself and things I had to work on myself that I, maybe I wasn't willing to work on.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为对于她而言，她教会了我很多关于，呃，关于我自己，以及那些我自身需要改进却可能一直不愿面对或没有意识到的事情。

sentences.en: I didn't recognize.
sentences.zh: 我以前没有意识到。

sentences.en: And she makes me better all around, you know, and, and, and also just made me better with patience as well.
sentences.zh: 她让我整个人变得更好，你知道的，而且，而且，还让我变得更有耐心。

sentences.en: And her handbag, of course, became sort of like a lucky charm for the team.
sentences.zh: 当然，她的手袋也成了这支球队的某种幸运符。

sentences.en: The one that won us a chip.
sentences.zh: 那个帮我们赢得总冠军的手袋。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Even I think it was at the Guggenheim for a little while.
sentences.zh: 甚至我想它还在古根海姆博物馆呆了一小段时间。

sentences.en: It's been at the Guggenheim.
sentences.zh: 它去过古根海姆博物馆。

sentences.en: I still, it's still there.
sentences.zh: 我到现在，它还在那儿。

sentences.en: Is it?

sentences.en: And I got the job done.
sentences.zh: 我把事情办妥了。

sentences.en: And when I was out there, I felt like I could be in the NBA.
sentences.zh: 当我上场时，我觉得自己完全可以进NBA。

sentences.en: I could belong and I knew I had more years to go and I had to still grow as a player physically, mentally.
sentences.zh: 我属于这里，我知道我还有好几年的路要走，在身体和心理上我作为一名球员还需要继续成长。

sentences.en: But to already go out there and feel very confident and feel good about my game already there.
sentences.zh: 但一上去就感到非常自信，对当时自己的球风感觉很棒。

sentences.en: And I said, man, the league's in trouble in a couple of years when I like get even more figured out, right?
sentences.zh: 当时我就说，天哪，等过几年我把这一切彻底摸透了，联盟就要有麻烦了，对吧？

sentences.en: I'm going to be a problem.
sentences.zh: 我要成为一个大麻烦。

sentences.en: And I damn sure it became a problem.
sentences.zh: 我敢肯定，我确实成为了一个大麻烦。

sentences.en: Let me ask you some league questions, okay?
sentences.zh: 我问你几个关于联盟的问题，好吗？

sentences.en: You know, the East this year, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，今年东部局势，对吧？

sentences.en: Giannis went to the Heat.
sentences.zh: 字母哥去了热火。

sentences.en: Kawhi looks like he's going to go to the Raptors.
sentences.zh: 伦纳德看起来要去猛龙了。

sentences.en: I know it's a little up in the air right now.
sentences.zh: 我知道现在一切还有点悬而未决。

sentences.en: Jalen Brown went to the Sixers.
sentences.zh: 杰伦·布朗去了76人队。

sentences.en: Who are you most worried about?
sentences.zh: 你最担心谁？

sentences.en: The Knicks.
sentences.zh: 尼克斯队。

sentences.en: That's all I need to worry about.
sentences.zh: 这就是我唯一需要担心的事。

sentences.en: Do you get why Jalen Brown is now on the Sixers?
sentences.zh: 你知道杰伦·布朗现在去76人队了吗？

sentences.en: Of all the teams for him to end up on, the fact they trade him to like one of their biggest rivals, pretty fun.
sentences.zh: 在所有能去的球队里，他们竟然把他交易到最大的死敌之一，这挺有意思的。

sentences.en: It's pretty fun.
sentences.zh: 这确实挺有意思的。

sentences.en: I mean, like I said, control the controllables.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就像我说的，控制你能控制的。

sentences.en: If I worried about all the uncontrollables in my life and professionally, I'd be lost in the sauce.
sentences.zh: 如果我担心生活和职业生涯中所有无法控制的事，我早就迷失自我了。

sentences.en: But of course, your buddy Mitch Robinson now on the Celtics.
sentences.zh: 但当然了，你的好兄弟米奇·罗宾逊现在去凯尔特人队了。

sentences.en: I know, that's tough.
sentences.zh: 我知道，这很难受。

sentences.en: That was a tough one.
sentences.zh: 那真是一次艰难的变动。

sentences.en: I have two questions about that.
sentences.zh: 关于这个我有两个问题。

sentences.en: In good conscience, could the team do Hackamich if you were playing the Celtics?
sentences.zh: 凭良心讲，如果你们对阵凯尔特人队，球队还会对米奇使用故意犯规战术吗？

sentences.en: That would be heartbreaking if you guys did that.
sentences.zh: 如果你们真那么做，那可就太伤人了。

sentences.en: I don't know how that—I don't even know if I could look at Mitch with a Celtics jersey on.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这——我甚至不知道自己能不能直视穿着凯尔特人球衣的米奇。

sentences.en: After everything, so I don't even know if I could—I'll just have to start laughing at Mitch when we see each other.
sentences.zh: 经历这一切之后，我甚至不知道自己能不能——每次见到他，我肯定都得先笑出来。

sentences.en: He owes me a pickup truck now I'm talking about that.
sentences.zh: 说到这个，他还欠我一辆皮卡车呢。

sentences.en: For what?
sentences.zh: 为了什么？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I just want a pickup truck.
sentences.zh: 我就是想要一辆皮卡车。

sentences.en: You just say to him, you owe me a pickup truck?
sentences.zh: 你就直接对他说，你欠我一辆皮卡车？

sentences.en: I just—you owe me a pickup truck.
sentences.zh: 我就是——你欠我一辆皮卡车。

sentences.en: But, you know, watching him shoot free throws as a fan is the most, like, emotional rollercoaster experience.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，作为球迷看他罚球绝对是最像坐过山车一样的体验。

sentences.en: Because you just want that guy—
sentences.zh: 因为你就是希望那家伙——

sentences.en: It's emotional rollercoaster watching a man shoot free throws?
sentences.zh: 看一个男人罚球就像坐过山车？

sentences.en: Oh, it is.
sentences.zh: 哦，确实如此。

sentences.en: Because you want him to succeed so badly.
sentences.zh: 因为你太希望他成功了。

sentences.en: That's not like walking up to a woman at a bar and saying all she could say to the worst is no.
sentences.zh: 这可不像是去酒吧走向一个女人，想着她最坏也就是拒绝你。

sentences.en: That's easier than watching Mitch the opposite shoot free throws.
sentences.zh: 那可比看米奇罚球要容易多了。

sentences.en: That's different.
sentences.zh: 那完全是两码事。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Because, you know, it's like you know he struggles with the free throws.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，就像你知道他罚球很挣扎一样。

sentences.en: You want him to shoot them so well.
sentences.zh: 你希望他罚得很好。

sentences.en: And then it ends up still being a struggle.
sentences.zh: 然后结果依然是一场挣扎。

sentences.en: What is the experience for the teammates when you're watching Mitch go through—
sentences.zh: 当你们看着米奇经历这些时，队友们的体验是什么样的？

sentences.en: Oh, we love it.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们可太喜欢了。

sentences.en: We love going to see him shoot free throws.
sentences.zh: 我们最喜欢看他罚球了。

sentences.en: What do you love about it?
sentences.zh: 你们喜欢它什么？

sentences.en: But just, one, it gets a foul.
sentences.zh: 首先，这能造成一次犯规。

sentences.en: Puts us closer to the bonus.
sentences.zh: 让我们离犯规奖金更近一步。

sentences.en: It gets closer for me and for all of us, like, whatever it's me, Jalen, anybody.
sentences.zh: 它让我们所有人，无论是我、杰伦还是任何人，都离得更近。

sentences.en: We get closer to, you know, getting that foul, getting to the free throw line.
sentences.zh: 我们离获得那个犯规、走上罚球线更近了一步。

sentences.en: Two, every time, you know, it happens, you know, it gives us breaks.
sentences.zh: 第二，每次这种事发生，你知道的，它能给我们争取休息时间。

sentences.en: It gives us a break to kind of reset, think about what we want to do next.
sentences.zh: 它给我们一个喘息的机会来重新调整，想想接下来要做什么。

sentences.en: And three, we believe in Mitch.
sentences.zh: 第三，我们相信米奇。

sentences.en: Like I said, we believe everyone on that team, one through 15.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，我们相信队里的每个人，从第1到第15人。

sentences.en: We know—we see each other get to put the work in and everything.
sentences.zh: 我们知道——我们看着彼此付出努力等等。

sentences.en: So when he goes up there, we're excited because we can't wait to talk junk when he makes it.
sentences.zh: 所以当他走上罚球线时，我们很兴奋，因为我们等不及在他罚进时去开玩笑了。

sentences.en: So we're always excited when we get to see Mitch go up there.
sentences.zh: 所以每次看到米奇走上去，我们总是很兴奋。

sentences.en: You know, we're almost at the end of our time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们的时间快要结束了。

sentences.en: But you know when you leave the building, you're going to have a similar experience again.
sentences.zh: 但你知道当你离开这栋大楼时，你会再次经历类似的体验。

sentences.en: They know I'm here.
sentences.zh: 他们知道我在这儿。

sentences.en: They know I'm here.
sentences.zh: 他们知道我在这儿。

sentences.en: When you came up—
sentences.zh: 当你走上来时——

sentences.en: What an honor.
sentences.zh: 这真是个莫大的荣幸。

sentences.en: Just be able to, like, represent joy for people in the city of New York seems like such a privilege.
sentences.zh: 能够为纽约市的人们代表快乐，感觉就像是一种巨大的特权。

sentences.en: And it's going to be that way for the rest of your time on the Knicks, probably for the rest of your life when you're in the city.
sentences.zh: 你在尼克斯队的余下时间里都会这样，可能你在城里的余生也都会如此。

sentences.en: Yeah, it'll be for the rest of my life.
sentences.zh: 是的，这会贯穿我的余生。

sentences.en: Talk about what that means to you.
sentences.zh: 聊聊这对你意味着什么吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, I talked about it after the game.
sentences.zh: 是的，我在赛后谈过这个。

sentences.en: If we're talking about, you know, the impact of this win, you know, you're talking about I leave and everyone, you know, congratulates and says champ, the word champ,
sentences.zh: 如果我们谈论这场胜利的影响，你知道的，我离开时每个人都祝贺我，叫我冠军，冠军这个词，

sentences.en: which is still crazy.
sentences.zh: 这听起来依然很疯狂。

sentences.en: We started this interview talking about how surreal it still is to have a championship, to bring so much joy to families, for them,
sentences.zh: 我们开始这次采访时还在谈论拥有一个总冠军、给家庭带来如此多的欢乐是多么不真实，

sentences.en: especially those families that have previous generations of Knicks fans who have been just begging for a chance to be in the NBA Finals,
sentences.zh: 尤其是那些尼克斯球迷的家族，他们的长辈一直渴望有机会进入NBA总决赛，

sentences.en: let alone winning the NBA Finals after 53 years and then last time being 27 years ago against the Spurs, too, ironically.
sentences.zh: 更不用说在53年后赢得NBA总决赛了，而上一次夺冠还要追溯到27年前对阵马刺队的时候，这也挺讽刺的。

sentences.en: I feel like a Love Island character getting back my phone after the playoffs and seeing these reels and these videos and these Instagram posts about the grandfather celebrating it with his son's kid and passing that kind of Knicks fandom down to the kid or the father who grew up watching the disappointment of 1999 or families and those people who have those lost loved ones.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己就像《爱情岛》里的嘉宾，季后赛结束后拿回手机，看到这些短视频、视频以及关于一位爷爷和儿子的小孩一起庆祝、将这种尼克斯球迷文化传承给小孩，或者那些从小伴随着1999年的失望长大的父亲、以及那些失去挚爱的家庭和人们的Instagram帖子时，我感觉自己仿佛与世隔绝了一阵。

sentences.en: And I know how special it is because I saw people in Brooklyn cheering and they got their own NBA team.
sentences.zh: 我知道这有多特别，因为我看到布鲁克林的人们也在欢呼，而他们明明有自己的NBA球队。

sentences.en: So that's kind of that's kind of crazy to do.
sentences.zh: 所以这感觉有点疯狂。

sentences.en: But it just shows, you know,
sentences.zh: 但这正好表明，

sentences.en: New York's so unified with each other when you give them something to be unified for and for us to reach the mountaintop and give so many people something to cheer for and so many people to have hope for.
sentences.zh: 当给纽约人一个团结的理由时，他们是如此团结；对我们来说，能够登顶巅峰，为这么多人带来欢呼和希望，

sentences.en: Uh, cause inspiring hope is, is one of the hardest things to do and for us to be able to do that is, is, is something truly special.
sentences.zh: 呃，因为激发希望是最难的事情之一，而我们能够做到这一点，真的是一件非常特别的事。

sentences.en: So just the last question, the margins in professional sports between winning and losing are very slim.
sentences.zh: 所以最后一个问题，在职业体育中，赢与输之间的差距非常微小。

sentences.en: So slim, you know, it's like one small decision changes everything.
sentences.zh: 非常微小，你知道的，就像一个小决定就能改变一切。

sentences.en: One small decision changes everything.
sentences.zh: 一个小决定就能改变一切。

sentences.en: Last year, you know, you guys are, are up big against the Pacers in the fourth quarter.
sentences.zh: 去年，你知道的，你们在第四节对步行者队领先优势很大。

sentences.en: They, they pull off a comeback against you this year.
sentences.zh: 今年他们对你们完成了逆转。

sentences.en: OG tips it a shot that if he missed that 999 times out of a thousand, I am dunking.
sentences.zh: OG补进的那记投篮，如果他在一千次里有九百九十九次没进，那我就要扣篮了。

sentences.en: I know you're saying you would have dunked it, but you know, it's, I'm dunking.
sentences.zh: 我知道你会说你会扣进，但你知道的，我是真要扣篮。

sentences.en: I'm telling you, I'm dunking it in.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你，我绝对能扣进去。

sentences.en: But, but it's, you know, no one would have blamed him if you missed that.
sentences.zh: 但是，但是你知道的，如果你没进，也没人会责怪你。

sentences.en: That was a sort of a miraculous shot.
sentences.zh: 那真是一种奇迹般的投篮。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah, of course.
sentences.zh: 对，对，对，当然。

sentences.en: And then just the level of intensity and focus that it takes.
sentences.zh: 还有所需的强度和专注度水平。

sentences.en: And it seems almost unbelievable that you can win once.
sentences.zh: 能赢一次似乎已经几乎不可思议了。

sentences.en: Does it then seem even more daunting to have to, have to, have to think, can we come back and win it again, back to back?
sentences.zh: 那么，要去思考‘我们能不能卷土重来再次赢得冠军，实现卫冕？’会不会觉得更加令人望而生畏？

sentences.en: Well, my competitive spirit says, you know, that's what we're planning to do.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的好胜心告诉我，这就是我们计划要做的事。

sentences.en: And now, you know, I know we were always the underdogs in every series.
sentences.zh: 现在，你知道，我知道我们在每个系列赛中一直都是不被看好的一方。

sentences.en: We got to be ready to always be looked at as the favorites.
sentences.zh: 我们必须准备好一直被视为夺冠热门。

sentences.en: And that's not something we, uh, we like a lot.
sentences.zh: 这不是我们呃、我们很喜欢的一种状态。

sentences.en: So we're going to have to go out there and then continue to have that underdog mentality, that mindset, and just, we're going to have to be even a better version of ourselves.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要走上赛场，继续保持那种不被看好的心态、那种思维方式，并且我们必须成为更好的自己。

sentences.en: Even though a lot of y'all say we were one of the best ever in the playoffs, we got to find another level because people are going to be ready for us this year and they're not
sentences.zh: 尽管你们很多人说我们在季后赛中是史上表现最好的球队之一，但我们必须找到一个新的高度，因为今年人们会为我们做好准备，他们不会

sentences.en: going to get caught slipping anymore.
sentences.zh: 再被我们打个措手不及了。

sentences.en: So.
sentences.zh: 所以。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I'm going to say it back to back.
sentences.zh: 我要说我们要实现卫冕。

sentences.en: We're going back to back.
sentences.zh: 我们要实现卫冕。

sentences.en: I ain't going to say that.
sentences.zh: 我可不打算这么说。

sentences.en: I'm going to say we're going to do our beSt.
sentences.zh: 我会说我们会尽力做到最好。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Thanks, champ.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，冠军。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 多谢。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 多谢。
